metadata.title: The central dynamics of M3, M13, and M92: Stringent limits on the masses of intermediate-mass black holes

notes: No star meets the eligibility criteria. The paper discusses potential high-velocity stars in M3 and M13 (T:p12-b1, T:p12-b3) and a rise in the M92 velocity-dispersion profile attributed to stars escaping that cluster (T:p14-b8), but these are cluster-kinematic outliers or cluster-escape candidates, not stars identified as unbound from the Milky Way.
